Selected outside sources

Editorial starting points, not a ranking.

  • The Hendon Mob results database

    The Hendon Mob · Free · Database

    Find recorded live tournament results, festivals, venues, and player records.

    Before you use it: Listed winnings are not net profit, a complete financial record, or proof of ability.

    Public page read · 2026-10-07 · Full listing

  • PokerNews live reporting

    PokerNews · Free · Reporting

    Follow reported hands, chip updates, and tournament coverage from current and past events.

    Before you use it: Reporting is selective and can be corrected; it is not a complete hand-history dataset.

    Public page read · 2026-10-07 · Full listing

  • Thinking Poker podcast

    Thinking Poker · Mixed · Podcast

    Long-form interviews and strategy discussions, with a public episode archive.

    Before you use it: Public episodes and paid supporter material are distinct.

    Public page read · 2026-10-07 · Full listing

These guides and sources also appear elsewhere in the catalogue. Cross-listing them does not add to the resource count. Selected sources are editorial starting points, not performance rankings or paid placements. Use study material away from play, and check the linked publisher for current details.
